_about: Bloodlines (round 30, Robert 2026-10-03): 'introduced around floor 20 ... percentage based with milestones ... only one dominant and one secondary ... found through legacy inheritances or a natural bloodline that shines through ... percentages decide if a player starts with one or has a hidden one.' Engine: Game.gd 'bloodlines'. A line's 'words' (stir, desc, power) may be rewritten by Dev in data/bloodline_words.json, which wins over these.

azure_dragon.name: Azure Dragon
azure_dragon.desc: The east wind's lord. Qi pools in your blood the way rain gathers in a dragon's coils.
azure_dragon.stir: Something long and patient uncoils behind your breastbone. The air tastes of coming rain.
azure_dragon.power50: Dragon's Patience: qi gathers faster in everything you do.

vermilion_phoenix.name: Vermilion Phoenix
vermilion_phoenix.desc: The south's undying bird. Your blood refuses endings.
vermilion_phoenix.stir: A warmth moves under your skin that no fire lit -- as if you'd been burned once, long ago, and come back.
vermilion_phoenix.power50: Rebirth from Ashes: once a day, a blow that would kill you leaves you standing at 40% health.

white_tiger.name: White Tiger
white_tiger.desc: The west's killing star. Your blood knows where the gap in the armour is.
white_tiger.stir: Your eyes find the seams in things -- the gap in a door, the weak link in a chain -- without your asking.
white_tiger.power50: Tiger's Eye: your blows find the gap -- some land for nearly double.

black_tortoise.name: Black Tortoise
black_tortoise.desc: The north's patient shell. Your blood was made to outlast.
black_tortoise.stir: Blows land on you like rain on old stone. You hadn't noticed how long you can stand.
black_tortoise.power50: The Shell Remembers: every blow lands lighter.

qilin.name: Qilin
qilin.desc: The benevolent beast that walks without bending grass. Fortune follows your blood.
qilin.stir: Coins turn up where you put your feet. Strangers smile at you and don't know why.
qilin.power50: Qilin's Blessing: the fallen leave more behind -- sometimes twice.

nine_tailed_fox.name: Nine-Tailed Fox
nine_tailed_fox.desc: A trickster's blood, thin as smoke and twice as hard to catch.
nine_tailed_fox.stir: People look at where you were a heartbeat ago. Your shadow seems to have more tails than it should.
nine_tailed_fox.power50: Foxfire Step: some blows meet only the place you were.

golden_crow.name: Golden Crow
golden_crow.desc: The three-legged bird that carries the sun. Your blood runs hot enough to scorch.
golden_crow.stir: Your palms are warm in the coldest room. Water steams where your hand rests on it.
golden_crow.power50: Sunfire Blood: your blows set what they strike burning.

kunpeng.name: Kunpeng
kunpeng.desc: The great fish that became the great bird. Your blood wants distance.
kunpeng.stir: Doors feel close; horizons feel near. Your legs want to keep going after the road ends.
kunpeng.power50: Ten Thousand Li: you run and step further than the body should.

asura.name: Asura
asura.desc: War-blood. The nearer you are to falling, the harder you hit.
asura.stir: When you're hurt, the hurt goes somewhere useful. You notice you're smiling in fights.
asura.power50: Asura's Wrath: below 40% health your blows strike far harder.

starborn_lattice.name: Starborn Lattice
starborn_lattice.desc: Not a beast's blood at all: the nanites themselves, folded into your line generations ago and remembering.
starborn_lattice.stir: The swarm in your veins hums a tune you never taught it -- older than you, and pleased to be heard.
starborn_lattice.power50: Ancestral Swarm: your nanites grow as though they'd done this before.
